title_en: Exploratory X1 (window truth): the stale list beats a fresh sample from the same window until N is a large share of the group
title_zh: 探索性 X1（窗口真相）：在样本人数达到群体的较大比例之前，旧榜单优于来自同一时间窗口的新样本榜单
reading_en: Scored on the window (the same stretch of time the fresh sample comes from), a fresh sample with every earlier choice kept (k=all) matched the stale list in 11 of 11 datasets within the sampled N (median 1% of the group where it did). Judged datasets where this took at least 30% of the group: k=all 0/11, k=5 0/9 (top-100 overlap: k=all 0/11, k=5 0/8). Exploratory; few draws per cell make single crossovers noisy.
reading_zh: 以“窗口”（新样本所取自的同一段时间）为标准，保留全部过往选择（k=all）时，在已抽样的 N 范围内，新样本在 11 个数据集中有 11 个追平了旧榜单；追平发生处的中位数约为群体的 1%。需要群体至少 30% 才追平的判定数：k=all 0/11，k=5 0/9（前 100 名重合度：k=all 0/11，k=5 0/8）。这是探索性结果，每格抽样次数不多，单个交叉点有噪声。
rule: Crossover N_s >= 30% of the group in most datasets (N_s = smallest N whose mean window-sample count score >= the stale list's score on the window truth; judged on W_ndcg100 at k=5 and k=all, both must agree; W_ov100 reported as a robustness check)

title_en: Exploratory X2 (window truth): shrinking toward the stale list helps most near the crossover
title_zh: 探索性 X2（窗口真相）：向旧榜单收缩在交叉点附近帮助最大

numbers.kappa_note: kappa is capped at 1e+06, which means 'all weight on the stale list'

reading_en: Shrinking a fresh window sample toward the stale list gains up to 0.763 NDCG@100 on the window truth, with the gain peaking at a median N of 20. Peak within one grid step of the X1 crossover: k=all 2/11, k=5 1/9 (only datasets whose crossover was reached can be judged). The median shrinkage strength kappa over cells is 16,965; a high kappa means the method leans on the stale list.
reading_zh: 把来自窗口的新样本向旧榜单收缩，对窗口真相的 NDCG@100 最多提高 0.763，增益峰值的中位数 N 为 20。增益峰值与 X1 交叉点相差不超过一格的情况：k=all 2/11，k=5 1/9（只有交叉点已出现的数据集才能判定）。各格收缩强度 kappa 的中位数为 16,965；kappa 越大，方法越依赖旧榜单。
rule: Gain of shrinking toward the stale list (shrunk minus count, window score W_ndcg100) peaks near the X1 crossover (peak at the crossover grid point or one grid step away; judged only where the crossover is reached inside the grid; k=5 and k=all must agree, verdict from the majority of judged datasets per k)

title_en: Exploratory X12: weighting recent choices more helps predict later choices
title_zh: 探索性 X12：更看重近期选择有助于预测之后的选择
reading_en: Weighting recent choices more beat the plain count list on later real choices (Truth B) in 179 of 223 cells (80%), lost in 2, and was indistinguishable in 42; the median gain over all cells is +0.013 NDCG@100. On the window score it wins 15 and loses 119 of 223, and on the held-out panel it wins 179 and loses 3 of 223. Exploratory, 11 dataset(s) with window samples.
reading_zh: 更看重近期选择，在 223 个格子中有 179 个（80%）预测之后真实选择（Truth B）的效果好于普通计数榜单，2 个更差，42 个看不出差别；所有格子的中位差为 +0.013（NDCG@100）。窗口得分上胜 15、负 119（共 223），留出面板上胜 179、负 3（共 223）。这是探索性结果，共 11 个有窗口样本的数据集。
rule: Share of (dataset, N, k) cells where recency-weighted counts beat plain counts on Truth B (B_ndcg100) with the 95% bootstrap interval of the difference above 0 (cells with >= 2 draws): supported if more than 50% of judged cells, not supported if fewer than 25%, else mixed; cells with the interval below 0 are reported as losses
